Warning: Personal input clash Any other input clashes with a planned slot: a course, a meeting, an appointment, overseas duty. q:leave.body: SETTINGS Inputs Members file for others On › A member may file a duty or commitment for someone else. Never leave, medical or SANS availability. THE CHECKS Crew rest and the working day Warning: No break day — too many days in a row On the programme more than 6 days in a row. How it works Leave, downchits and inputs Note: An input closes its hours Every input closes the man for the hours it covers, from the moment it is filed. One a scheduler has taken off the programme closes nothing. Warning: On leave + planned A man on leave is planned for a flight, sim, duty or ground slot. Warning: Downchit + planned A medically down man is planned. On ATT B he may still stand a duty, sim or ground slot

q:flying.body: SETTINGS Flying lines Brief before take-off 2h20 Sets the suggested B on a line with no brief typed, and a blank B is checked against it. With no in-time typed, crew rest counts to this B. A published day keeps its B until it is published again. Step before take-off 1h A man counts as busy from step: clashes and the crew list follow it. It and dekit set the shortest tight turn. It also decides when a LATE SHOW crew-rest ring turns from dashed to solid. Dekit after landing 30 min A man counts as busy until dekit. It and step set the shortest tight turn. Debrief after landing 2h Ends a flyer's day: tomorrow's crew rest, the long day, OIL and Insights hours count to here, and so does the flight
